unit.why: A short biographical anecdote: in his youth the tsaddik (apparently the Seer of Lublin) kept his eyes closed for seven years to avoid seeing anything indecent, which left him short-sighted.
unit.boundary_note: Separate numbered item (כב); the subject is not named here and is taken from the surrounding section.

stories.start_quote: בימי חורפו סגר את עיניו שבע שנים
stories.summary_en: In his youth the tsaddik kept his eyes shut for seven straight years so as not to see anything indecent, opening them only to read his book during prayer and study, and as a result his sight grew weak and he became short-sighted.

quotes: סגר את עיניו שבע שנים רצופות

tags.why: Guarding the eyes from indecent sights
